pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Proxmox VE cluster REST API endpoints (/cluster/*) and pvecm command. Provides PVE::API2::Cluster*, PVE::CLI::pvecm, PVE::Cluster::Setup (node join/leave, SSL certificate management).
Runtime tools: faketime (sys-libs/libfaketime) for cert date manipulation, rsync for node data sync, openssl for certificate operations.
